solves.reason: 본문: It is reasonable to ask + important in helping + a variety of → reasonable-important-variety
본문: organisation or individual + buy goods in bulk + wholesaler transports → individual-bulk-transports
본문: distribution channel + then store them + gain access → distribution-store-access
③ insignificant: 뒤에서 도매상의 유용한 역할이 나열되므로 important가 맞음
② sell: 도매상이 제조업체에서 대량 구매(buy)해야 저장-운송 흐름 성립
④ lose: 도매상의 이점이 접근을 '얻는' 것이므로 gain이 맞음
between a producer and a ____: 유통의 양끝 = producer와 retailer
buy goods in ____: in bulk(대량으로)가 관용 표현
can also ____ a large range: 상품 보유/비축 = stock
reasonable ≈ sensible (합리적인)
transports ≈ delivers (운반/배달)
variety ≈ diversity (다양성)
straight(곧바로) ↔ indirectly(간접적으로)
gain(얻다) ↔ forfeit(상실하다)
(A) pass the goods = 전달하다, (B) a valid pass = 허가증
대량구매→소매상판매 = wholesaler
between a ____(produce) and a retailer → producer (-er 행위자 접미사)
the ____(distribute) channel → distribution (명사형 복합명사)
acting as ____ between producer and retailer → the middle step
As a result, ____, the retailer only has to talk to ONE wholesaler → instead of contacting all producers (대비 구조)
